blocks.x: And, oh, back to the White City. Where did the Pelicans play?

The Pelicans played on Cleveland and Counting Avenue, around that way somewhere. They had the ballpark there. Yeah. And of course later on they moved to, you know, where they, you know, they're fresh out there on Counting and Tulane.
Yes. So, the White City is, was not the same place where they played. I mean, it's, later on, Pelican Stadium was right near there, huh?
Well, it was on Cleveland Avenue.
Yeah, but then later on they moved to Tulane and Carrollton.
And where was White City? Which corner was it on?

Man, it's been so long. Yeah, well I can look it up. It was on, anyway, it was on Counting and Tulane because we used, I used to go out there with my dad and all, you know, and we, I was always... Did you play for the ball games or not? No, not, oh, did he play for the ball? Yeah, he played once for Heinemann Park with, with Charlie Bowler had a band out there for years. And my dad played at the racetrack also with Charles Bowler too, Charles had a, and I played the, I played the political, Dally Hoos with Charles Bowler, and I played the parades with Charles Bowler.
